tagline: Spot it. Fix it. Prove it.

descriptions.overview: What risks your code, dependencies and images carry, why they matter and how to fix them.
descriptions.analyses: Scan history for this workspace, with type, status and results.
descriptions.new: Choose the target, declare the scope and review what will run before you launch.
descriptions.repositories: Connect your repositories and choose the code you want to scan.
descriptions.images: The container images you've analyzed and the repository each is built from.
descriptions.domains: Domains you own, proven by DNS, to bring the findings of your own ZAP or Nuclei runs. Dynamic testing from here is still in development.
descriptions.integrations: Manage code providers and check the AI status.
descriptions.account: Your access: password and two-factor authentication.
descriptions.users: Invite your team, assign roles and revoke access.
descriptions.pulls: Each PR is reviewed for what it introduces, not for what was already there.
descriptions.cves: Every vulnerability published in NVD, with active exploitation (KEV) and exploit probability (EPSS), searchable locally.
descriptions.compliance: Evidence for audits and customers, and EU CRA reporting when it applies.
descriptions.threats: Model the system with the approach you prefer (STRIDE, LINDDUN, PASTA, attack trees, ATT&CK) and check the threats against your scans.
descriptions.default: Results for the selected target, with steps and coverage limits in plain view.
descriptions.policies: Rules that apply to every repository.

dast.title: Next in dynamic testing
dast.description: What comes after the passive web scan of these domains:

plan.scan: API testing from an OpenAPI description, in safe mode first
plan.auth: Sign-in to the application with a test account you declare
plan.evidence: Active tests only with an administrator's authorization, recorded in the run
